title: AI and Neurodiversity: Whose Brain Was This Built For?
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: AI tools are built for one way of thinking. The people they leave out

The sharpest moment was about the line between accommodation and dependency. If a neurodivergent person uses AI to do tasks their brain finds difficult, is that support or reliance? The answer depends on agency
